schema.description: Client-scoped request for an agent the caller can edit.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent whose limit the request concerns.

client_id.description: Explicit opaque spend-client ID, retained without normalization and not inferred from the authenticating OAuth application. Control characters and the synthetic __deleted_clients__ aggregation ID are not valid spend-client IDs.

business_justification.description: Optional explanation of why the increase is needed.
